svg.title: Two-dimensional search for nearby businesses
svg.desc: A labeled city map centers a dashed circular search radius on a blue user marker. Three restaurant symbols and two cafe symbols fall inside the search area.
svg.metadata: Map geometry adapted from tiles by Stamen Design under CC BY 3.0, using OpenStreetMap data.

g.text: Map tiles by Stamen Design, under CC BY 3.0. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
